info.title: AceData_MiniMax_Video
info.description: Create MiniMax videos from supported content inputs, duration and resolution settings. Retrieve tasks to obtain the completed video. Bind your own Ace Data Cloud credential privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in Authorization. Usage is billed to your account. Never place a token in chat or shared examples. Start: https://platform.acedata.cloud/?from=coze

async.description: Set to true to immediately return the task ID without the need for a callback_url, and you can poll through the Tasks API.

model.description: Model name, currently only supports the official value `MiniMax-H3`.

ratio.description: Video aspect ratio. Text-to-video is required and cannot be `adaptive`; image-to-video defaults to `adaptive`; multimodal reference is optional.

text.description: Video prompt words, all scenes must be filled in and not exceed 7000 characters.

type.description: Content type: text, image, video, or audio.

role.description: Material usage. The first and last frames use `first_frame` / `last_frame`; reference materials use `reference_image` / `reference_video` / `reference_audio`.

type.description: Content type: text, image, video, or audio.

url.description: Media address, supports public network URL, `mm_file://{file_id}` or the corresponding media type's Base64 data URI.

content.description: Official MiniMax H3 V2 multimodal input array. Each request must include a non-empty `text`; supports images at the beginning and end or multimodal reference materials, but the two types of scenes cannot be mixed.

duration.description: Video duration, required, integer between 4 and 15 seconds.

callback_url.description: Optional task status callback URL. When provided, asynchronous mode is automatically enabled, the interface immediately returns the task identifier, and the final result will be sent to this URL.

post.description: Use MiniMax H3 V2 to generate videos with multimodal content. By default, it waits for the generation to complete; when passing `async: true` or `callback_url`, Full input requirements: https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/minimax-videos Submit once with async=true. Retain task_id and poll the matching task tool; a task ID is not a completed result. Do not resubmit while pending.

post.summary: Query MiniMax H3 video generation tasks. Both single tasks and task lists use the official H3 task fields.

200.description: Operation successful. Single task returns the official `task`, batch query returns the official task object composed of `items` and `total`. AceDataCloud local history deletion extension returns `id` and `deleted`.
